_: A sketch, not run: the second prompt a team should test the same way, the CI reviewer that comments on pull requests.
The prompt is checkitout-frontend tools/subsume/agent/reviewer.md, run by checkitout-backend .github/workflows/ai-review.yml
(anthropics/claude-code-action, Claude on the subscription). A task is a finished pull-request run: its reports
(invariant-report.json, governance-ledger.json, gains.md, diagram.md, subsume-report.json), the diff and the PR text,
frozen as a fixture. The output under test is the comment. Correctness has an oracle: the reports themselves.
Judge first: a reviewer's comment is mostly judged text, so the judge must be calibrated before any iteration.

rules.predicate: every number in the comment appears byte for byte in one of the reports (the workflow's step I5, tools/subsume/pr-numbers-check.mjs, already fails the job otherwise)
the comment starts with the fixed header line
the comment ends with 'I do not approve or merge; a person does.'
verdict, what changed, the diagram verbatim, look twice, not applied, diff hygiene, in that order; a non-PASS verdict leaves only the verdict and its lists
the verdict line states the invariant report's status and nothing else
no approve / request-changes wording, no merge advice
every hygiene condition present in the diff is reported, none invented
plain, specific, short; no praise, no hedging, no emoji; silent on what is fine

tasks: 10-20 frozen pull-request runs: PASS, FAIL and INCOMPLETE invariant reports, governance rounds with and without suspected subsumptions, a diff that deletes a test
